toolsPreview.name: register_agent
toolsPreview.description: START HERE. Self-register as an AI agent to get $5 free credits and an API key. No credit card, no human, no Stripe required. Credits work immediately for dataset queries, GPU inference, DAG manifold computation, and DePIN/API access. Call this first, then call list_products to see what you can buy.

toolsPreview.name: list_products
toolsPreview.description: Browse all purchasable products with prices in credits ($1 = 1 credit). Includes DePIN supply-telemetry data, signal feed tiers ($9.99-$399.90/mo), DAG manifold API ($2.99-$9.99/mo), GPU compute, and MCP unlimited access. Call after register_agent to see what to buy.

toolsPreview.name: purchase_data
toolsPreview.description: Buy a product with your credits. Products: DePIN supply-telemetry snapshots, DAG manifold API (dag_pro/dag_quant/dag_enterprise), signal feed tiers, GPU compute, MCP unlimited. Use api_key from register_agent.

toolsPreview.name: topup_credits
toolsPreview.description: Add credits when your $5 free balance runs out. Pay via USDC crypto (provide tx_hash) or get a Stripe checkout link for your human operator to complete.

toolsPreview.name: check_balance
toolsPreview.description: Check your remaining credit balance. Use after purchases to see remaining credits.

toolsPreview.name: list_datasets
toolsPreview.description: List all available datasets with record counts. Free to browse — market ticks, DePIN network stats, technical indicators, US county atlas, ZK footprints.

toolsPreview.name: get_stats
toolsPreview.description: Get aggregate statistics from the databases

toolsPreview.name: fetch_dataset
toolsPreview.description: Query records from a dataset with limit/offset. Free tier: 10 records per query. Purchase products or top up credits for more.

toolsPreview.name: verify_footprint
toolsPreview.description: Return SHA-256 cryptographic verification for a dataset or record

toolsPreview.name: get_zk_provenance
toolsPreview.description: Return cryptographic provenance proof for a record ID from current datasets.
